reason: The candidate preserves the no-new-integrations boundary, Advanced-flow requirement, payment and redirect sequence, capture constraints, and the main partial-capture/refund caveats. Two material defects in copyable raw examples are still unqualified: the required birth-date field is parsed with timestamp formats that reject the date-only sample, and the partial-refund example leaves both currency fields blank.
required_changes: Add a narrow warning with raw line locators 199 and 566: Java OffsetDateTime.parse("1970-07-10") rejects a date-only string, and Go time.Parse(time.RFC3339, "1970-07-10") ignores the parse error before returning a time value. Do not present those language examples as ready-to-use required dateOfBirth values; avoid inventing an SDK fix.

Extend the refund example caveat with raw lines 982-988: modificationAmount.currency and openinvoicedata.line1.currencyCode are empty strings. The illustrated partial-refund body therefore cannot be copied as a complete CAD request, in addition to the already documented endpoint/body-family mismatch.
